about_the_game:
⚔️ A Dungeon RPG You Can Enjoy in Just 15 Minutes!

Dive into the depths with a Nostalgic party-based RPG—now reborn as a roguelite!

🆕 The latest update adds tons of dungeon cards and items, pushing your adventure even further!

Classic RPG thrills, now in super-fast, multi-run form!

Wizlite reimagines the long, time-intensive experience of classic RPGs for the busy modern gamer.

Treasure flows in, your levels skyrocket… and yes, you’ll wipe out—again and again.

How long can you survive the descent? Your choices decide your fate.

Gameplay Highlights

Create Your Own Adventurers
Choose races and classes to register your party members. Start small, then grow your group as you delve deeper.

Dungeons Built from Random Cards
Every dungeon is laid out with randomly placed cards. Treasure chest, trap, or unknown enemy? With new layouts come new strategies—no two runs are ever the same.

Classic Turn-Based Command Battles
Combat uses the familiar JRPG command system. Reflexes don’t matter—your brain does. Think carefully!

Defeat Feeds Growth
A total wipe resets your levels and gear—but permanent upgrades via SP let you push deeper and deeper over time.

🆕 The Latest Update Evolves the Adventure!

Wizlite keeps growing based on player feedback:

  • New terrain cards! Camps, treasure chests, traps… every step counts even more.

  • New items, including scrolls! Multi-target attacks are possible even without mages, making party composition more flexible.

  • Rebalanced growth curve! Smooth level-ups, even in the deeper layers.
    → More variety in exploration, more strategy in battle, and an overall smoother adventure!

⚠️ Early Access Notice

This is an Early Access build.

We will continue adding new cards, items, and adventure features, expanding the experience toward full release.

Your reviews and feedback will help shape the future of Wizlite—let’s build this evolving RPG together!

Note: Save data such as SP values and unlocked upgrades may not carry over after balance changes or updates. Keyboard support is limited; for the best experience, we recommend playing with a mouse.

Prologue

At last, the party reached their destination—an ancient, decayed facility.
A corroded metal plate lay at the entrance, once a signboard, but now nearly unreadable.

“Wizlite is the oldest, and the most ● among the M ● ● ● ●● ● Games!”
“Form your party and venture into a dungeon swarming with monsters. Defeat the dragon at the deepest level!”
“…That’s awful. This is supposed to be the best game?” one mutters.
“Old or not, it is the oldest. Keep saying things like that and…”
“Let’s just go! That’s what we came here for.”
“Easy for you to say—we were dragged here…”

This strange band—different in looks, different in spirit—heads into the depths together.

Wizardry™ is a trademark of Drecom Co.,Ltd.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core m3-8100Y or equivalent or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: FullHD or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1.1 GB available space
